purpose: Highest-value first hardware batch: decode safe-capacity for L4 IL=1024 OL=512 TP=1 across all 10 clocks (top-10 missing scheduler cells; 6.9%->56.4% lookup coverage).

stability.PRIMARY: steady-state backlog from vLLM /metrics: vllm:num_requests_waiting slope<=eps over the steady-state window (after warmup ramp, before injection ends); KV not pinned ~100% with growing queue; run_ok (no OOM/preemption/timeout).
stability.SECONDARY: coarse drain-corrected served ratio over the INJECTION window only; NEVER gate on whole-run aggregate throughput.
stability.WARNING: served_ratio ~= 1/duration_ratio (one signal, not two) and both are biased low by finite-batch tail drain (tail ~ OL*p99_tpot); do NOT threshold served_ratio>=0.95 on benchmark_duration.
stability.slo_filter: p99_tpot<=bucket applied per-SLO post-hoc in calibrate_decode_capacity.

search.on_max_rate_stable: record C as lower bound, confirmed_knee=false
search.on_min_rate_unstable: record C=served@min_rate as lower bound, confirmed_knee=false, flag shape_infeasible_below_min

run.max_concurrency: PENDING: set from vLLM reported KV blocks after dry run; dry_run uses 32; unified across all capacity runs

replication.aggregate: a point is STABLE only if ALL reps stable; C_point = MIN achieved output_token_throughput over stable reps (conservative); never average a stable with an unstable outcome.

order_rationale: Descending freq, server stays up, clocks set live via nvidia-smi -ac. Descending avoids the flagged strictly-increasing order and puts the hottest (max-freq) runs first while the GPU is coolest; each freq reuses the previous freq's converged boundary scaled by freq ratio as its seed. Temperature is logged per run for post-hoc thermal-bias check.

frequencies.seed_note: static fallback = 3.0*f/2040 clamped; runtime prefers previous-freq boundary * (f/prev_f)
